Venue: BYDFi
Headline: BYDFi Invite Friends & Win Big — Every Draw Wins!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Dear BYDFi Users,
The BYDFi Autumn Futures Challenge is coming soon! Compete across three leaderboards for a total prize pool of 100,000 USDT in Futures Bonus. Register and meet the participation requirements to compete on the Futures Profit, Futures ROI, and Daily Trading Volume leaderboards. Eligible users can earn rewards from multiple leaderboards!
📅 Event Period: 2026/10/31 00:00 – 2026/12/01 00:00 (UTC+8)
👉 Join Now
🏆 Three Leaderboards, Exciting Rewards
1. Futures Profit Leaderboard | 30,000 USDT in Futures Bonus
The top 10 users ranked by cumulative Futures profit during the event will receive rewards.
2. Futures ROI Leaderboard | 30,000 USDT in Futures Bonus
The top 10 users ranked by cumulative Futures ROI during the event will receive rewards.
## Each leaderboard’s prize pool is allocated as follows:
Rank | Prize Pool Allocation | Prize Pool per Rank or Tier
1st | 22% | 6,600 USDT
2nd | 18% | 5,400 USDT
3rd | 12% | 3,600 USDT
4th–6th | 28% | Share 8,400 USDT
7th–10th | 20% | Share 6,000 USDT
3. Daily Futures Trading Volume Leaderboard | Total Pool of 40,000 USDT in Futures Bonus
The top 3 users ranked by Futures trading volume each day will receive Futures Bonus rewards.
Daily Prize Pool = 40,000 USDT ÷ Number of Event Days
Rank | Daily Reward
1st | Daily Prize Pool × 50%
2nd | Daily Prize Pool × 30%
3rd | Daily Prize Pool × 20%
The Futures Profit and Futures ROI allocations above represent prize pools for each rank or tier, rather than fixed individual rewards. Individual rewards are calculated according to the rules below.
📊 Individual Reward Calculations
1. Futures Profit and Futures ROI Leaderboards
Individual Reward = Tier Prize Pool × 50% × (Individual Trading Volume Share + Individual Performance Share)
Individual Trading Volume Share: The user’s Futures trading volume ÷ Total Futures trading volume of all users in the same rank tier.
Individual Performance Share: For the Profit leaderboard, the user’s profit ÷ Total profit of all users in the same rank tier. For the ROI leaderboard, the user’s ROI ÷ Sum of the ROI values of all users in the same rank tier.
Each of the two shares is capped at 50%.
2. Daily Futures Trading Volume Leaderboard
The top 3 users ranked by Futures trading volume each day will receive rewards.
Individual Reward = 40,000 USDT ÷ Number of Event Days × Applicable Rank Percentage
The reward percentages for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place are 50%, 30%, and 20%, respectively. These are fixed allocations of the daily prize pool. No individual trading volume share calculation or 50% individual share cap applies.
🎁 Reward Distribution
Daily Trading Volume Leaderboard: Rewards for the previous week will be distributed every Wednesday.
Cumulative Profit and ROI Leaderboards: Rewards will be distributed after the event ends and final data verification is completed.
All rewards will be issued as Futures Bonus. Eligible uses, validity periods, offset rules, and expiration conditions are subject to the platform’s applicable rules.
Users can check their BYDFi Futures Account and relevant rewards pages for reward credits and Bonus usage rules.
📋 Event Rules
1. Users must register a BYDFi account and complete the required KYC verification.
2. Users must hold assets equivalent to at least 100 USDT in their Futures Account.
3. Users must successfully register through the event page to participate and receive rewards.
4. Users must reach a cumulative Futures trading volume of at least 500 USDT during the event to qualify for the Profit and ROI leaderboards.
5. Users must reach a daily Futures trading volume of at least 500 USDT to qualify for that day’s Trading Volume leaderboard.
6. BYDFi reserves the right to disqualify users and revoke rewards in cases of cheating, wash trading, bulk account registrations, or any other abuse of the event rules.
7. In the event of any discrepancies or inconsistencies between different language versions, the English version shall prevail.
